upstream: frozen demand-disabled S0-seed42, selected epoch 13; identical upstream for all paired new fits
metadata: snapshot_unverified primary; observed-only availability diagnostic; no historical metadata correctness claim
train_rows: shared development training rows with at least 100 rolling eligible SKUs; common to every new fit
validation: all 6191 validation transitions; complete 1857 unseen-target denominator
global_statistics: strictly prior during training; frozen at TRAIN_CUTOFF during validation
selector_screen: repeat models gaining >=10 unseen hits at 25 or 50 against dot; repeat static control whenever dynamic qualifies
ranker_selection: maximum unseen hits@10 satisfying the preserved discovery artifact's recall guard 0.7558833119851873 and NDCG floor 0.5918928743676547; then NDCG; first strict improvement wins; failures are diagnostics without a selected alias
guardrail_audit: Corrected from the initial recall shorthand before any downstream fit; verified stored artifact guard and simultaneous NDCG floor. Selector fits are unaffected.
ranker_screen: repeat changes gaining >=5 unseen hits@10 versus matched control with recall and NDCG no more than 0.002 lower; always repeat matched controls
final_evidence: mean gain >=10 unseen hits@10; no mean recall or NDCG decrease; customer-clustered paired 95% interval lower bound >0; compare preserved discovery checkpoint separately
candidate_context: one 128D four-head candidate attention block; no positions; direct, learned-user-dot, zero-initialized residual heads
quota_repeat_order: selector score for repeats and unseen separately, same rule for dot/MLP; differs from historical personal-frequency repeat ordering, which is replayed separately
fixed_slate_policy: P3-P5 use the original S0 personal-repeat 50-item slate. Selector-ranked repeat slots are P6. A completed dot-repeat policy probe revealed lower quality; one partially trained component probe was archived before restarting independent component screens. Both policy evidence and the correction are retained.
